name: GitLab Clone - Ollama Playwright Test - Slack Report

parameters.command:
#!/bin/bash

# Extract repository info from GitLab webhook
REPO_URL="{{ $json.repository.git_http_url }}"
REPO_NAME="{{ $json.repository.name }}"
BRANCH="{{ $json.ref }}"
COMMIT_SHA="{{ $json.after }}"

echo "Repository: $REPO_NAME"
echo "Branch: $BRANCH"
echo "Commit: $COMMIT_SHA"
echo "URL: $REPO_URL"

# Create workspace directory
WORKSPACE="/tmp/n8n-workspace/$REPO_NAME-$(date +%s)"
mkdir -p $WORKSPACE
cd $WORKSPACE

# Clone repository
echo "Cloning repository..."
git clone $REPO_URL .

# Checkout specific commit
echo "Checking out commit: $COMMIT_SHA"
git checkout $COMMIT_SHA

echo "Code cloned successfully to: $WORKSPACE"
echo "WORKSPACE_PATH=$WORKSPACE" > /tmp/workspace.env

# List files in workspace
echo "Files in workspace:"
ls -la

#!/bin/bash

# Start Ollama service
echo "Starting Ollama service..."

# Check if Ollama is already running
if pgrep -x "ollama" > /dev/null; then
    echo "Ollama is already running"
else
    echo "Starting Ollama..."
    # Start Ollama in background
    ollama serve > /var/log/ollama.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 10
    
    # Wait for Ollama to be ready
    for i in {1..30}; do
        if ollama list > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Ollama started successfully"
            break
        fi
        echo "Waiting for Ollama to start... ($i/30)"
        sleep 2
    done
fi

# Check available models
echo "Available Ollama models:"
ollama list

# Pull required models if not available
echo "Ensuring required models are available..."
ollama pull llama3.2:latest || echo "Failed to pull llama3.2, using available models"

echo "Ollama setup completed"

#!/bin/bash

# Start Playwright MCP Server
echo "Starting Playwright MCP Server..."

# Kill existing MCP processes
pkill -f "playwright-mcp" || true
pkill -f "mcp-server" || true
sleep 2

# Load workspace path
source /tmp/workspace.env

# Start Playwright MCP server
echo "Starting Playwright MCP server for workspace: $WORKSPACE_PATH"

# Create MCP config for Playwright
cat > /tmp/mcp-config.json << EOF
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "playwright": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@modelcontextprotocol/server-playwright"]
    },
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "$WORKSPACE_PATH"]
    }
  }
}
EOF

# Start MCP servers in background
echo "Starting Playwright MCP..."
npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-playwright > /var/log/mcp-playwright.log 2>&1 &
PLAYWRIGHT_PID=$!

echo "Starting Filesystem MCP..."
npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem "$WORKSPACE_PATH" > /var/log/mcp-filesystem.log 2>&1 &
FILESYSTEM_PID=$!

echo "MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID=$PLAYWRIGHT_PID" > /tmp/mcp.env
echo "MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID=$FILESYSTEM_PID" >> /tmp/mcp.env

sleep 5
echo "Playwright MCP servers started successfully"
echo "Playwright PID: $PLAYWRIGHT_PID"
echo "Filesystem PID: $FILESYSTEM_PID"

#!/bin/bash

# Load environment variables
source /tmp/workspace.env
source /tmp/mcp.env

echo "Running test cases in workspace: $WORKSPACE_PATH"
cd "$WORKSPACE_PATH"

# Initialize test results
TEST_START_TIME=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
TEST_RESULTS_FILE="/tmp/test-results-$(date +%s).json"

echo "{
  \"start_time\": \"$TEST_START_TIME\",
  \"workspace\": \"$WORKSPACE_PATH\",
  \"tests\": []" > "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"

# Check for different test frameworks and run accordingly
TEST_EXIT_CODE=0

# Check for package.json and npm tests
if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "Found package.json, running npm tests..."
    
    # Install dependencies
    npm install
    
    # Run tests
    if npm test > /tmp/npm-test.log 2>&1; then
        echo "NPM tests passed"
        TEST_STATUS="passed"
    else
        echo "NPM tests failed"
        TEST_STATUS="failed"
        TEST_EXIT_CODE=1
    fi
    
    # Add npm test results
    echo ",{\"type\": \"npm\", \"status\": \"$TEST_STATUS\", \"log\": \"/tmp/npm-test.log\"}" >> "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"
fi

# Check for Playwright tests
if [ -f "playwright.config.js" ] || [ -f "playwright.config.ts" ]; then
    echo "Found Playwright config, running Playwright tests..."
    
    # Install Playwright if not installed
    npx playwright install
    
    # Run Playwright tests
    if npx playwright test > /tmp/playwright-test.log 2>&1; then
        echo "Playwright tests passed"
        TEST_STATUS="passed"
    else
        echo "Playwright tests failed"
        TEST_STATUS="failed"
        TEST_EXIT_CODE=1
    fi
    
    # Add Playwright test results
    echo ",{\"type\": \"playwright\", \"status\": \"$TEST_STATUS\", \"log\": \"/tmp/playwright-test.log\"}" >> "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"
fi

# Check for Python tests
if [ -f "requirements.txt" ] || [ -f "pytest.ini" ] || find . -name "test_*.py" | grep -q .; then
    echo "Found Python tests, running pytest..."
    
    # Install requirements
    [ -f "requirements.txt" ] && pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    # Run pytest
    if python -m pytest > /tmp/pytest.log 2>&1; then
        echo "Python tests passed"
        TEST_STATUS="passed"
    else
        echo "Python tests failed"
        TEST_STATUS="failed"
        TEST_EXIT_CODE=1
    fi
    
    # Add pytest results
    echo ",{\"type\": \"pytest\", \"status\": \"$TEST_STATUS\", \"log\": \"/tmp/pytest.log\"}" >> "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"
fi

# Custom MCP integration test
echo "Running MCP integration test..."
if ps -p "$MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID" > /dev/null && ps -p "$MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID" > /dev/null; then
    echo "MCP services are running"
    MCP_STATUS="passed"
else
    echo "MCP services failed"
    MCP_STATUS="failed"
    TEST_EXIT_CODE=1
fi

echo ",{\"type\": \"mcp_integration\", \"status\": \"$MCP_STATUS\", \"playwright_pid\": \"$MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID\", \"filesystem_pid\": \"$MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID\"}" >> "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"

# Finalize test results
TEST_END_TIME=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
echo "],
  \"end_time\": \"$TEST_END_TIME\",
  \"overall_status\": \"$([ $TEST_EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ] && echo 'passed' || echo 'failed')\",
  \"exit_code\": $TEST_EXIT_CODE
}" >> "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"

echo "TEST_RESULTS_FILE=$TEST_RESULTS_FILE" > /tmp/test-summary.env
echo "TEST_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE" >> /tmp/test-summary.env

echo "Test execution completed with exit code: $TEST_EXIT_CODE"
echo "Results saved to: $TEST_RESULTS_FILE"

# Display summary
cat "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE"

#!/bin/bash

# Load test results
source /tmp/test-summary.env

# Read test results
TEST_RESULTS=$(cat "$TEST_RESULTS_FILE")

# Extract key information from GitLab webhook
REPO_NAME="{{ $json.repository.name }}"
BRANCH="{{ $json.ref }}"
COMMIT_SHA="{{ $json.after }}"
COMMIT_MESSAGE="{{ $json.commits[0].message }}"
AUTHOR_NAME="{{ $json.commits[0].author.name }}"
COMMIT_URL="{{ $json.commits[0].url }}"

# Determine status emoji and color
if [ "$TEST_EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
    STATUS_EMOJI=":white_check_mark:"
    STATUS_COLOR="good"
    STATUS_TEXT="PASSED"
else
    STATUS_EMOJI=":x:"
    STATUS_COLOR="danger"
    STATUS_TEXT="FAILED"
fi

# Create Slack message payload
cat > /tmp/slack-payload.json << EOF
{
  "text": "GitLab CI/CD Test Results",
  "attachments": [
    {
      "color": "$STATUS_COLOR",
      "title": "$STATUS_EMOJI Test Results: $STATUS_TEXT",
      "fields": [
        {
          "title": "Repository",
          "value": "$REPO_NAME",
          "short": true
        },
        {
          "title": "Branch",
          "value": "${BRANCH#refs/heads/}",
          "short": true
        },
        {
          "title": "Commit",
          "value": "<$COMMIT_URL|${COMMIT_SHA:0:8}>",
          "short": true
        },
        {
          "title": "Author",
          "value": "$AUTHOR_NAME",
          "short": true
        },
        {
          "title": "Commit Message",
          "value": "$COMMIT_MESSAGE",
          "short": false
        },
        {
          "title": "Test Details",
          "value": "\`\`\`json\n$TEST_RESULTS\n\`\`\`",
          "short": false
        }
      ],
      "footer": "n8n GitLab CI/CD",
      "ts": $(date +%s)
    }
  ]
}
EOF

echo "Slack payload created:"
cat /tmp/slack-payload.json

# Send to Slack
echo "Sending notification to Slack..."
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
  --data @/tmp/slack-payload.json \
  https://hooks.slack.com/services/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

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Slack notification sent successfully"
else
    echo "Failed to send Slack notification"
fi

# Clean up temporary files
echo "Cleaning up temporary files..."
rm -f /tmp/slack-payload.json
rm -f /tmp/workspace.env
rm -f /tmp/mcp.env
rm -f /tmp/test-summary.env

echo "Slack notification process completed"

#!/bin/bash

# Cleanup resources
echo "Cleaning up resources..."

# Load environment files if they exist
[ -f /tmp/workspace.env ] && source /tmp/workspace.env
[ -f /tmp/mcp.env ] && source /tmp/mcp.env

# Stop MCP processes
if [ ! -z "$MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID" ]; then
    echo "Stopping Playwright MCP (PID: $MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID)"
    kill $MCP_PLAYWRIGHT_PID 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ ! -z "$MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID" ]; then
    echo "Stopping Filesystem MCP (PID: $MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID)"
    kill $MCP_FILESYSTEM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Clean up workspace (keep last 5 workspaces)
if [ ! -z "$WORKSPACE_PATH" ]; then
    echo "Cleaning up old workspaces..."
    find /tmp/n8n-workspace -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*-*" | sort | head -n -5 | xargs rm -rf
fi

# Clean up log files older than 7 days
find /var/log -name "*.log" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
find /tmp -name "*test*.log" -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Cleanup completed"

}
